The 'why' question itself provides a clear and specific direction: the authors know exactly what they need to do, namely justify their choice of the decoder-only architecture. According to the criteria, clarification questions that give a direct action count as explicit statements. The comment also specifies the exact location (Line 235) and the precise topic of the explanation (the motivation for choosing decoder-only transformers), so authors know what needs to be done and how to apply it. Therefore, the comment contains an explicit action with concrete implementation details.
